text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa won the bet. However, her 
former teacher remained in a state where 
anything could happen at any moment. The 
remaining time was short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa grows impatient in her 
pursuit of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. 
...And standing before her appear none 
other than El Condor Pasa and Special 
Week!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Guided by El Condor Pasa, who knew the 
world firsthand, the Trainer and Nakayama 
Festa were to be taught a unique training 
method.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa had felt it— the hope for 
the future in Nakayama Festa's 
Classic-tier running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa for the future. Nakayama 
Festa for her former homeroom teacher. The 
tag team vowed to seize hope together.
